hardening.minimized_reason: Standalone shell with PIE, stack protection, RELRO and a non-executable stack; no feature-minimization claim.
hardening.pledge_reason: Service permissions remain the Werewolf form's responsibility; the shell adds no package-enforced capability policy.

changes.what: Package mksh and make it the owner of /bin/sh in Werewolf's merged /usr layout.
changes.why: Provide consistent shell semantics without installing BusyBox's applet collection for SSH access.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi supplies equivalent mksh packaging and /bin/sh ownership; review compatibility before retiring this context.
